data.exact_reserve_text:
There was limited claims movement on our closed years (2009-2019), primarily from improvements on the 2019 year of account offset by deterioration on the 2017 year. The result on the closed years for financial year 2022 was a profit of $2.7m.
In the financial year there was prior accident year favourable development of claims incurred of $6.3 million (2021: $5.3 million adverse).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Improvements on the 2019 year of account contributed to limited favourable prior years movement.
Deterioration on the 2017 year of account offset improvements in other closed years.

named_events.loss_description: Significant losses from catastrophes, in particular Hurricane Ian (net loss of $16.8m) have contributed to a loss to date on the year.
Continuing favourable claims development in particular on catastrophe losses from Hurricane Laura and winter storms has supported a positive outturn on the year.
Losses arising from COVID-19 (net losses before LPT of $121.5m) and associated reinsurance costs have contributed to the $58.5m loss on the year.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2022 with gross claims outstanding of $561.739m (as at 1 Jan 2022). Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net prior-year strengthening of approximately $45.46m (c. 8.1% of opening gross claims), driven largely by increases in development on older years (notably the 2020 and 2017 groupings) partially offset by releases on some older years (including 2013/2014/2019). The report also notes limited movement on closed years overall (2009-2019), with improvements on the 2019 year offset by deterioration on the 2017 year. Named catastrophe activity in the reporting period included Hurricane Ian (net $16.8m loss) and continuing development from prior-catastrophe events such as Hurricane Laura; COVID-19 impacts were ceded under an LPT arrangement and discussed separately.
raw_causal_phrases: There was limited claims movement on our closed years (2009-2019), primarily from improvements on the 2019 year of account offset by deterioration on the 2017 year.
In the financial year there was prior accident year favourable development of claims incurred of $6.3 million (2021: $5.3 million adverse).
Losses arising from COVID-19 (net losses before LPT of $121.5m) and associated reinsurance costs have contributed to the $58.5m loss on the year.
The Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) agreement with Berkley Insurance Company which was entered into in 2020 has removed all net impact of COVID-19 losses from the Syndicate

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative estimates by underwriting year) on page 32. That calculation excludes the two most recent underwriting years (2021 and 2022) per the methodology. The report also contains a P&L statement phrase noting 'prior accident year favourable development of claims incurred of $6.3 million' (this is a claims-incurred / P&L line and differs from the gross triangle-derived PYD). All monetary amounts above are reported in the syndicate's native currency (USD). Some narrative references to specific LOB impacts are high-level and do not quantify gross PYD by LOB, so per-LOB reserve movements are not quantified and are estimated with lower confidence.
